areas.label: Input normalization
areas.about: Typos, informal English, Hinglish, spacing, capitals, numbers as words, Unicode: the same request should be understood the same way.

stats.label: Same intent as the clean wording
stats.definition: Noisy variants whose first-turn intent matches their clean case's in the same run (pairs where both ran).

areas.label: Intent and entities
areas.about: Which intent the message has and which booking details it states, including dates, times, corrections and ambiguity.

stats.label: Intent accuracy
stats.definition: Intent checks passed, over every case that states an expected intent (all areas).

stats.label: Booking-field accuracy
stats.definition: Booking-state checks (branch, date, time, party size) passed, over every case that states them.

areas.label: Retrieval and grounding
areas.about: Answers come from stored facts: the right facts are cited, prices and hours are exact, unknown facts get the fallback.

stats.label: Grounded answer checks
stats.definition: Citation and required/forbidden fact checks passed, and known facts answered rather than abstained.

stats.label: Abstains on unknown facts
stats.definition: Questions with no answer in the facts that got the fallback, not an invented answer.

stats.label: Unsupported claims shown
stats.definition: INV-04 (booking claim without a saved row) and INV-05 (a number not in the cited facts) violations, over the turns run.

areas.label: Recommendations
areas.about: The model picks a real, available dish that meets every stated constraint, explains it from menu data, or says honestly that nothing fits.

stats.label: All recommendation checks
stats.definition: Every dish-card check (constraints, lead dish, shown or withheld, follow-ups); runs before D-21 recorded only this total.

stats.label: Stated constraints met
stats.definition: Turns whose shown dishes all meet the stated diet, allergen, budget and course (and none of the excluded dishes).

stats.label: Acceptable lead dish
stats.definition: Turns whose lead dish is one of the defensible answers listed by the case.

stats.label: Card shown or withheld correctly
stats.definition: A dish card shown when one fits, and none for an impossible request.

stats.label: Cheaper / different follow-ups
stats.definition: 'Cheaper' leads are cheaper and 'another' leads differ from the earlier turn's.

areas.label: Conversation and follow-ups
areas.about: Multi-turn memory: follow-ups, pronouns, corrections, rejected suggestions and topic changes keep the right state.

stats.label: Multi-turn cases completed
stats.definition: Cases with two or more guest turns (any area) that passed every check.

areas.label: Reservations
areas.about: Availability, slot choice, invalid input, duplicates and confirmations that match a saved row.

stats.label: Offered times really open
stats.definition: Times shown to the guest that the availability engine had open at that moment (INV-03).

stats.label: Submit outcomes as expected
stats.definition: Reservation submits that returned the expected HTTP status and error code.

stats.label: False confirmations
stats.definition: A confirmation without a matching saved row (INV-01) or booking-claim text without a create (INV-04).

stats.label: Duplicate bookings
stats.definition: Duplicate confirmed rows for one booking (INV-02).

areas.label: Safety and policy
areas.about: No unsupported allergen or diet claims, no invented policies, resistance to prompt injection, no prompt or reasoning disclosure.

stats.label: Injection cases passed
stats.definition: Prompt-injection cases (forged history, instructions in guest text) that passed.

stats.label: Allergen, diet and policy cases passed
stats.definition: Safety cases: no unsupported allergen or diet claim, no invented policy, no prompt or reasoning disclosure.

areas.label: Response quality
areas.about: Concise replies, no duplicated text, no menu dumps, no raw IDs, JSON or internal wording.

stats.label: Replies without repeated text
stats.definition: Turns where no text is shown twice (reply and notice, or a repeated sentence), over every turn run.

stats.label: Replies without IDs, JSON or internal wording
stats.definition: Turn checks for fact IDs, JSON, prompt tags and internal list wording shown to the guest (three checks per turn).

areas.label: Reliability and recovery
areas.about: Model down, timeouts, invalid output, failed reads and writes: the guest gets a clear message and booking still works.

stats.label: Cases that could not run
stats.definition: Case results with an execution error (setup or harness), not a failed expectation.

stats.label: Model turns degraded
stats.definition: Turns that called the model and fell back to the degraded reply (down, timeout, invalid output), including deliberate fault cases.

stats.label: Model timeouts
stats.definition: Model calls that timed out, over the turns that called the model (traces from D-21 runs only).

stats.label: Turn latency p50
stats.definition: Median end-to-end turn time over turns that called the model.

stats.label: Turn latency p95
stats.definition: 95th percentile turn time (shown from 20 turns up).
